workflows.title: Landmark Tour
workflows.shows: Schedule → Service Call → Action, sending a goal and waiting on its feedback.

workflows.title: Battery Watchdog
workflows.shows: Topic Trigger with a conditions filter, so the workflow only wakes for messages that matter.

workflows.title: Send the Rover Somewhere
workflows.shows: An n8n Form with a dropdown of places, driving an Action with live feedback.

workflows.title: Mission Planner
workflows.shows: The model plans, n8n executes: plain language in, a JSON plan out, executed step by step.

workflows.title: Self-Documenting Robot
workflows.shows: Runtime discovery turned into an operator manual, written from the live ROS graph.

workflows.title: Incident Responder
workflows.shows: The same trigger as 02, but an agent decides whether to dock, finish, or e-stop.
workflows.inactive: Ships inactive on purpose: it listens to the same battery_low event as workflow 02, so running both means two things racing to command the rover. Turn 02 off before turning this on — the pair is meant to be shown as a before/after, fixed logic against a reasoned decision.
